service=operations[ec.web.parameters.op] if (!service) {ec.web.response.setStatus(400);ec.web.sendJsonResponse([errors:['Unknown test operation']]);return} def input=new groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parseText(ec.web.parameters.input ?: '{}') // Reproduce a forged editable preference after parent screen actions have finished. if (input.testActiveOrg in ['AUDIT_QA_A','AUDIT_QA_B','_NA_','']) { ec.user.setPreference('ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION',input.remove('testActiveOrg')) } def result=ec.service.sync().name(service).parameters(input).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse([result:result,errors:ec.message.errors,validation:ec.message.validationErrors*.message])
